title: A game's snippets
description: <Game>/snippets.json: the game and its .cxx snippets. tools/catalog.py checks the rules a schema can't (the folder name, files, unique ids).

id.description: The game's id on fusionfix.io (the page /games/<id>/): the folder's name in lower case.

title.description: The game's name as players know it.

exe.description: File names of the game's exe.

loader.description: The file name Ultimate ASI Loader gets in this game (one of loader.json names).

exeFolder.description: Where the exe is, relative to the game's install folder, when it isn't there itself (Gameface/Binaries/Win64). The loader and the snippets go there.

id.description: <Folder>.<file name without .cxx>. Never reused for another snippet: share links and installs refer to it.

file.description: The .cxx file next to this one.

title.description: A short name, shown as the snippet's switch.

description.description: What it does, in one plain sentence.

folder.description: Where it goes, relative to the exe's folder: scripts (the usual), plugins, or the folder itself.

exe.description: The exes it works with, when not every exe of the game.

arch.description: The architectures it works with, when not the game's.

loader.description: The oldest Ultimate ASI Loader version it works with (10.0.1 or later).

source.description: Where it comes from (a plugin's repository, a forum post).

default.description: Chosen when the game's page opens.
